findings.passage: Rep. LaVon Bracy Davis, D-Ocoee, asked, “what has changed since 2018?”
findings.note: A news story quotes her question in a House subcommittee hearing on HB 1223, which would lower the minimum age to buy rifles and shotguns from 21 to 18. The 2018 reference is the school-safety law that set the age at 21. The story's date line is 2024-01-31; the hearing was the day before.
